narr: Storms developed over central Missouri and southeast Kansas ahead of an approaching cold front during the evening of the 12th and moved across southwest and south central Missouri through the early morning of the 13th. Sporadic wind gusts of 60 to 70 mph downed trees and power poles from Arcadia and Fort Scott in Kansas eastward to near Joplin, Billings, Marshfield, and Cabool. Widespread rainfall accumulations over an inch occurred across the entire region, with a band of two to five inches extending along and north of a line from Pittsburg, Kansas to Bolivar to Salem. Flash flooding was reported in Pittsburg, Kansas where water rescues and stranded vehicles were reported. Flash flooding also occurred near Couch in Oregon County when Townfork Creek rose rapidly out of its banks.
